settings.threshold_units: 21-day suffix reward after trading a random real prelude; no boundary reset
settings.threshold_estimation: median / 90th percentile of paired real-2018 validation update standard errors
settings.selection_score: mean paired real-2018 validation gain over updates 5-8 versus C at the same step
settings.pool_switch_policy: finish in-flight episodes; new pool applies at the next natural reset (at most 41 extra steps per env)
settings.limitation: seed=0; 2018 validation only; no 2019/event performance used for calibration
